title: Approved - Make This Ride Last

Sing ONLY the supplied new car-approval lyrics. Begin with the approval hook immediately; match the source's full-song length and emotional arc. Include ONE featured PEDAL STEEL GUITAR instrumental section at its lyric marker: unmistakable smooth sliding steel tone, sustained bends, glissandi and lyrical high-register phrases, no lead singing.
